Washington, D.C. - More than Politics and Monuments
programme.desc: Barely a day goes by without images of Washington, D.C. being in the media. The US capital is the nation's political heart, and its iconic landmarks exude a sense of history.

programme.title: Focus on Europe
programme.desc: Tensions continue to rise in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta following the arrival of tens of thousands of migrants. Local resident Sabah Hamed Mohamed is helping them.

programme.title: Arts Unveiled
programme.sub-title: She risks everything to expose India's hidden worlds
programme.desc: What does it take to document the stories most people never see? Award-winning Indian photojournalist Smita Sharma has spent years investigating human trafficking, gender inequality, and other hidden social issues across South Asia. Her work has appeared in National Geographic, TIME and The New York Times. However, things haven't been easy.
